ShimmerText.description: Animated gradient text for live "Thinking…" / "Searching…" labels.

Collapse.description: Height-animated container (CSS grid trick, no measuring).

props.name: name
props.description: Used for initials & accessible label.

props.name: icon
props.description: Custom icon; defaults to a sparkle (gradient) or a monogram of `name` (monogram).

props.name: initials
props.description: Show initials instead of the icon (e.g. for human users).

props.name: variant
props.description: "agent" renders the accent gradient, "user" a neutral tile.

props.name: appearance
props.description:
Agent tile style. "gradient" (default) is the accent gradient tile;
"monogram" is a flat letter tile tinted by `color`.

props.name: color
props.description:
Monogram tile color: a CSS color, "accent", "ink", or "auto" (a muted
color picked from the name so each agent is recognisable). Default "auto".

props.name: filename
props.description: Shown in the header instead of the language.

props.name: hideHeader
props.description: Hide the header bar (copy button floats on hover instead).

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Max height before scrolling, e.g. 320 or "20rem".

props.name: streaming
props.description: Show a blinking caret at the end (while streaming).

props.name: actions
props.description: Extra actions rendered in the header.

StreamingMarkdown.description: Markdown + smooth token reveal + caret. Use this for live LLM output.

props.name: streaming
props.description: True while tokens are still arriving.

props.name: smooth
props.description: Smooth out bursty chunks with a frame-paced reveal. Default true.

props.name: sources
props.description: Sources used to resolve `[1]`-style inline citations.

props.name: renderCode
props.type: ((code: string, language: string, streaming: boolean) => ReactNode)
props.description: Override code block rendering (e.g. plug in Shiki).

props.name: streaming
props.description: Show a blinking caret at the end of the content.

props.name: sources
props.description: Sources used to resolve `[1]`-style inline citations.

props.name: renderCode
props.type: ((code: string, language: string, streaming: boolean) => ReactNode)
props.description: Override code block rendering (e.g. plug in Shiki).

Sources.description: Collapsible "Used N sources" block with favicon stack.

props.name: label
props.description: Label override, receives the count.

InlineCitation.description: Inline numbered citation with a hover card preview.

props.name: content
props.description: The reasoning text (markdown) — or pass `children`.

props.name: streaming
props.description: True while the model is still thinking.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds spent thinking. Measured automatically if omitted.

props.name: summary
props.description: Optional one-line summary shown under the title.

props.name: variant
props.description: "card" (bordered) or "inline" (minimal, flows with the message).

props.name: labels
props.type: { thinking?: ReactNode; thought?: ((seconds: number) => ReactNode) | undefined; }
props.description: Label overrides.

props.name: name
props.description: Tool identifier, e.g. "web_search".

props.name: title
props.description: Friendly title shown instead of the raw name (e.g. "Searching the web").

props.name: durationMs
props.description: Duration in milliseconds.

props.name: children
props.description: Custom output renderer — overrides the default JSON/text output view.

ToolCallGroup.description: Stack of tool calls with a subtle connecting header, e.g. "Used 3 tools".

ToolApproval.description: Human-in-the-loop confirmation for any agent action.

props.name: title
props.description: e.g. "Send this email to 3 recipients?", "Book flight for $412?", "Run shell command?"

props.name: details
props.description: Key/value rows describing exactly what will happen (amount, recipient, date…).

props.name: command
props.description: Optional command / code preview (rendered as a code block).

props.name: children
props.description: Any custom preview (email draft, diff, product card…).

props.name: rememberLabel
props.description: Label for the "remember" checkbox. Pass `false` to hide it.

AgentQuestion.description: The agent asks the user a structured question (choice or free text).

props.name: multiple
props.description: Allow selecting several options.

props.name: allowCustom
props.description: Show a free-text field ("Other…").

props.name: answered
props.description: Once answered the card locks and shows the answer.

props.name: onSubmit
props.type: ((answer: { optionIds: string[]; text?: string | undefined; }) => void)

props.name: name
props.description: Display name (shown above assistant messages).

props.name: avatar
props.description: Avatar node, avatar props, or `false` to hide.

props.name: actions
props.description: Rendered under the message (e.g. <MessageActions/>).

props.name: variant
props.description:
"bubble": user messages in a bubble on the right (default)
"flat":   everything left-aligned with avatars (document style)

props.name: copyText
props.description: Text copied by the copy button. Omit to hide it.

props.name: alwaysVisible
props.description: Keep visible instead of revealing on hover.

Thread.description: Scrollable message list that sticks to the bottom while content streams.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the scroll container.

props.name: contentClassName
props.description: Classes for the centered content column.

props.name: hideScrollButton
props.description: Hide the floating "scroll to bottom" button.

ModelSelector.description: Dropdown for picking a model, agent, persona or mode.

props.name: side
props.description: Which side the menu opens on. Defaults to "top" (good inside a prompt input).

props.name: label
props.description: Header label inside the menu.

props.name: status
props.description: "streaming"/"submitted" turns the send button into a stop button.

props.name: allowAttachments
props.description: Enable file attachments (button, drag & drop, paste).

props.name: attachments
props.description: Controlled attachments. If omitted, attachments are managed internally.

props.name: references
props.description: Context chips shown above the input (e.g. a referenced image).

props.name: onVoice
props.description: Show a microphone button.

props.name: toolbar
props.description: Extra controls on the left of the toolbar (e.g. <ModelSelector/>).

props.name: actions
props.description: Extra controls on the right of the toolbar, before send.

props.name: hint
props.description: Footer hint. `false` hides it.

props.name: variant
props.description: "chips" (compact pills) or "cards" (grid with descriptions).

EmptyState.description: Welcome screen shown before the first message.

TaskPlan.description: Vertical timeline of an agent's plan / workflow steps.

props.name: showProgress
props.description: Show "3 of 6" + progress bar in the header.

props.name: stateLabel
props.description: Override the state label.

props.name: used
props.description: Tokens (or credits) used.

props.name: cost
props.description: Cost in currency units, e.g. 0.046.

props.name: variant
props.description: "card" with breakdown, "bar" inline, or "ring" compact.

AgentHandoff.description: Inline divider showing control passing from one agent to another.

HandoffBanner.description: Banner for escalating a conversation from AI to a human (support use-cases).

props.name: agentName
props.description: Human agent name once connected.

props.name: eta
props.description: e.g. "~2 min"

Artifact.description: Side panel / card for generated documents, code, charts, itineraries, etc.

props.name: copyText
props.description: Text for the built-in copy button.

props.name: children
props.description: Body when not using tabs.

ConversationList.description: Sidebar with threads grouped by date, search and "New chat".

VoiceOrb.description: Animated orb that visualizes a voice agent's state.

props.name: level
props.description: Live audio amplitude 0–1 (mic level while listening, output level while speaking).

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter in px.

VoiceDial.description: Instrument-style dial for a voice agent: ticked bezel, level disc and speaking ripples.

props.name: level
props.description: Live audio amplitude 0–1 (mic level while listening, output level while speaking).

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter in px.

VoiceWave.description: Small animated equalizer bars — use for "speaking" indicators.

VoicePanel.description: A complete voice-call surface: orb, status, transcript and call controls.

props.name: name
props.description: Agent name shown above the status.

props.name: transcript
props.description: Live transcript line (what the user or agent is saying).

props.name: elapsed
props.description: Call duration in seconds.

ChatWidget.description: Floating launcher + chat panel for embedding an agent on any website.

props.name: greeting
props.description: Teaser bubble shown next to the launcher while closed.

props.name: contained
props.description: Render inline (position: absolute within parent) instead of fixed to the viewport.

props.name: children
props.description: Panel body — typically <AgentChat compact />

MessageParts.description: Renders every part of a message: text, reasoning, tools, approvals, sources, files.

props.name: streaming
props.description: The message is currently being streamed.

props.name: renderTool
props.type: ((part: ToolPart, ctx: { name: string; status: ToolStatus; }) => ReactNode)
props.description: Return a node to custom-render a tool (generative UI); return undefined for the default card.

props.name: renderData
props.description: Render custom `data-*` parts.

props.name: onToolApproval
props.type: ((decision: { id: string; approved: boolean; part: ToolPart; }) => void)

props.name: toolTitles
props.description: Friendly titles per tool name, e.g. { web_search: "Searching the web" }

props.name: renderCode
props.type: ((code: string, language: string, streaming: boolean) => ReactNode)

props.name: onImageReference
props.description: Adds "Ask about this image" to the lightbox of image attachments.

AgentChat.description:
Batteries-included chat surface: thread, messages, reasoning, tools,
approvals, sources, empty state, follow-ups and the prompt input.

props.name: header
props.description: `true` renders a default header from `agent`; or pass your own node.

props.name: welcome
props.type: { title?: ReactNode; description?: ReactNode; icon?: ReactNode; }
props.description: Empty-state title/description.

props.name: suggestions
props.description: Starter prompts shown in the empty state.

props.name: followUps
props.description: Follow-up chips shown above the input after the last answer.

props.name: toolbar
props.description: Extra controls in the prompt toolbar.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message shown at the end of the thread.

props.name: compact
props.description: Tighter spacing for widgets & side panels.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focus the input on mount. Defaults to `true` unless `compact`.

props.name: variant
props.description: Message layout.

props.name: renderCode
props.type: ((code: string, language: string, streaming: boolean) => ReactNode)

props.name: renderTool
props.type: ((part: ToolPart, ctx: { name: string; status: ToolStatus; }) => ReactNode)
props.description: Return a node to custom-render a tool (generative UI); return undefined for the default card.

props.name: renderData
props.description: Render custom `data-*` parts.

props.name: onToolApproval
props.type: ((decision: { id: string; approved: boolean; part: ToolPart; }) => void)

props.name: toolTitles
props.description: Friendly titles per tool name, e.g. { web_search: "Searching the web" }

AgentCore.description: Arc-reactor style "presence" for an AI agent — reacts to state and audio.

props.name: level
props.description: Live loudness 0–1.

props.name: spectrum
props.description: Optional frequency bins 0–1 (from useAudioAnalyser). Synthesized from `level` when omitted.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter in px. Default 300.

props.name: label
props.description: Center content (e.g. agent name).

HudPanel.description: Sci-fi framed panel with corner brackets — the building block of HUD layouts.

props.name: code
props.description: Small code shown on the right of the header, e.g. "SYS-01".

props.name: status
props.description: Right-side header slot (status, actions).

props.name: scanlines
props.description: Subtle CRT scanlines + moving scan bar.

props.name: glow
props.description: Accent glow around the border.

RadialGauge.description: 270° arc gauge for telemetry: CPU, confidence, context window, latency…

props.name: tone
props.description: Fixed tone, or thresholds chosen automatically when "auto".

props.name: format
props.description: Format the center value.

props.name: live
props.description: Pulse the last point.

HudStat.description: Telemetry readout: label, big mono value, delta and sparkline.

props.name: delta
props.description: Percentage change; positive renders as success.

props.name: invertDelta
props.description: Invert delta colors (e.g. latency: lower is better).

props.name: levels
props.description: Bins 0–1. When omitted, bars are synthesized from `level`.

props.name: mirror
props.description: Mirror bars around the vertical center.

CommandConsole.description: Terminal-style command line for operating an agent by text commands.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the scroll area. Default 280.

BootSequence.description: Animated startup checklist — great for agent "wake up" moments and onboarding.

props.name: interval
props.description: ms between steps. Default 320.

HudBackground.description: Ambient grid + glow + optional sweeping scan line. Place inside a `relative` container.

DataTicker.description: Continuously scrolling status strip (markets, system events, agent activity).

AgentDetails.description: What one agent is doing: status, current activity, model, token usage, time and recent steps.

AgentGraph.description: Animated tree of agents: who delegated to whom, who's working, and where work is flowing.

props.name: links
props.description: Extra peer-to-peer links (drawn dashed), in addition to the parent tree.

props.name: direction
props.description: Layout direction. Default "right".

props.name: levelGap
props.description: Space between depth levels.

props.name: siblingGap
props.description: Space between siblings.

props.name: showDetails
props.description: Open a details popover when a node is clicked. Default true.

props.name: renderDetails
props.description: Replace the popover content.

TraceTree.description: Nested trace of agent, LLM and tool spans with a live waterfall timeline.

props.name: now
props.description: Current time (ms from trace start) for running spans. Auto-advances when omitted.

AgentHub.description: Hub-and-spoke ("octopus") view: an orchestrator reaching out to the agents it coordinates.

props.name: hub
props.description: The orchestrating agent in the center.

props.name: agents
props.description: Agents (or tools) the hub reaches out to.

props.name: size
props.description: Square size in px (scales down to fit). Default 560.

props.name: sway
props.description: Gently sway the tentacles. Default true.

props.name: showDetails
props.description: Open a details popover when an agent is clicked. Default true.

AttitudeIndicator.description:
An aviation attitude indicator re-imagined as an agent's presence:
the horizon steadies when idle, rolls gently while thinking, and responds
to audio while listening or speaking. The bezel pointer shows `value`.

props.name: value
props.description: Bezel pointer 0–100 (e.g. confidence, progress, context used).

props.name: level
props.description: Live loudness 0–1 — tilts the horizon while listening/speaking.

props.name: label
props.description: Large label drawn in the sky (e.g. "Awaiting approval").

props.name: sublabel
props.description: Small caption under the label (e.g. "Executor / K-03").

props.name: caption
props.description: Third line, e.g. "Observe → Propose → Confirm".

props.name: tone
props.description: Instrument markings color. Default "warning" (ochre).

RunCard.description: A single agent run: title, run id, status chip and a step timeline with rich step content.

props.name: actions
props.description: Header actions.

TelemetryChart.description: Readout + gridded line chart for latency, throughput, success rate, cost…

props.name: value
props.description: Big readout; defaults to the last data point.

props.name: xLabels
props.description: X-axis labels (shown at even intervals).

props.name: yTicks
props.description: Y-axis tick count. Default 4.

props.name: formatY
props.description: Format y-axis labels.

ToolCallRow.description: Compact, single-line tool status — for dense lists and dashboards.

props.name: progress
props.description: 0–100 shows a progress bar while running.

SegmentedMeter.description: Block-style meter for context windows, quotas and budgets.

props.name: caption
props.description: Right-side caption; defaults to "NN% used".

props.name: detail
props.description: Text under the bar, e.g. "12,480 / 32,000 tokens".

EventLog.description: Structured event stream (`event` + `key=value` fields) for agent runs and audits.

props.name: footer
props.description: Footer prompt, e.g. "Awaiting operator input".

Lightbox.description: Full-screen image viewer with zoom (wheel, pinch, double-click, buttons), pan and keyboard navigation.

props.name: index
props.description: Index of the image to show.

props.name: onReference
props.description: Adds an "Ask about this image" action — e.g. to reference it in the chat composer.

props.name: download
props.description: Show a download button. Default true.

ImagePreview.description: A single image with loading state that opens a zoomable lightbox.

props.name: zoomable
props.description: Click opens a lightbox. Default true.

props.name: aspect
props.description: CSS aspect ratio, e.g. "16/9". Uses the image's own when omitted.

ImageGallery.description: Responsive grid for 1–N images (generated images, screenshots, product photos) with a shared lightbox.

props.name: max
props.description: Max tiles before a "+N" overflow tile. Default 4.

SegmentedControl.description: A compact single-choice toggle group with a sliding indicator.

props.name: block
props.description: Stretch to the container width.

TaskCard.description: Compact card for one agent task: status, agent, progress, schedule, tags.

props.name: actions
props.description: Extra controls, rendered in the footer.

props.name: draggable
props.description: Enable HTML5 drag (used by TaskBoard).

TaskBoard.description: Kanban board of agent tasks with drag-and-drop between columns.

props.name: onMove
props.description: Called when a task is dragged to another column.

props.name: onAdd
props.description: Shows a "+" button per column.

TaskList.description: Dense table of agent tasks: status, agent, progress, schedule.

props.name: renderActions
props.description: Row actions, e.g. run / pause / menu.

TaskCreator.description: Form for handing an agent a job: what to do, who does it, when, what it may do on its own, and the budget.

props.name: templates
props.type: { label: string; title: string; instructions: string; }[]
props.description: Starter templates shown above the instructions.

TokenUsage.description: Token breakdown (input, cached, reasoning, output) with per-kind cost.

props.name: cached
props.description: Input tokens served from cache.

props.name: reasoning
props.description: Hidden reasoning / thinking tokens.

props.name: pricing
props.description: Pricing per 1M tokens — used to compute cost when `cost` is omitted.

props.name: cost
props.description: Total cost override.

props.name: caption
props.description: Small caption, e.g. the model name or period.

ContextWindow.description: What's filling the model's context window — system prompt, history, tools, files — and how much is left.

props.name: limit
props.description: Model context size in tokens.

props.name: variant
props.description: "bar" (default) or "grid" (100 cells, one per 1%).

props.name: warnAt
props.description: Usage ratio (0–1) from which to warn. Default 0.8.

props.name: warning
props.default: (free) => `Only ${formatNumber(free)} tokens left — older messages will be summarized soon.`
props.description: Warning text; receives the free token count.

TokenCounter.description: Inline "1.2k tok · $0.004" chip for messages, tool calls and runs.

props.name: detail
props.description: Optional detail shown on hover, e.g. "812 in · 405 out".

UsageChart.description: Stacked bar chart of usage over time — tokens or spend per day, split by model or agent.

props.name: format
props.description: Format values (axis + tooltip). Default compact number.

RunTimer.description: Live elapsed timer for an agent run, with an estimate of time left and an optional timeout ring.

props.name: startedAt
props.description: When the run started (ms since epoch). The timer ticks while `running`.

props.name: elapsed
props.description: Or pass a fixed elapsed time in ms (e.g. for finished runs).

props.name: progress
props.description: Progress 0–100 — used to estimate the time remaining.

props.name: timeout
props.description: Max run time in ms; shows a ring and warns as it gets close.

LatencyBreakdown.description: Where the time went in one response: queue, time to first token, generation, tools.

props.name: outputTokens
props.description: Output tokens, to show tokens per second for the generation phase.

props.name: generationId
props.description: Which segment is generation (for tokens/sec). Default "generation".

TimeAgo.description: Relative time ("3 min ago") that updates itself; hover shows the exact time.

AgentCard.description: Profile card for an agent: identity, status, model, tools and key stats.

props.name: actions
props.description: Footer actions (buttons).

props.name: maxTools
props.description: Max tool chips before "+N". Default 4.

AgentPicker.description: Searchable list for choosing which agent handles something.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Max list height before scrolling. Default 320.

ModelBadge.description: Inline model chip: provider tile, name and optional context size.

ModelCard.description: Spec card for a model: context, pricing, speed, quality and capabilities.

ModelCompare.description: Side-by-side model comparison. The best value in each numeric column is highlighted.

props.name: capabilities
props.description: Capabilities to show as columns. Default: tools, vision, reasoning.

ModelUsageTable.description: Usage per model: requests, tokens, cost, share of spend and latency, with a totals row.

props.name: period
props.description: Period caption, e.g. "Last 30 days".

LatencyTag.description: "842ms" — green, ochre or red by threshold.

props.name: thresholds
props.description: [good, slow] thresholds in ms. Default [800, 2500].

props.name: value
props.description: Percent change, e.g. 12.5 or -3.

props.name: invert
props.description: For metrics where lower is better (cost, latency).

ContextPill.description: Mini ring + percent, e.g. context used.

CapabilityTags.description: Icon-only capability row with tooltips (vision, tools, reasoning…).

MessageMeta.description: One-line footer for an answer or run: model · tokens · cost · time · speed.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds.

props.name: speed
props.description: Tokens per second.

StatTile.description: Dashboard KPI tile: label, big value, change and a sparkline.

props.name: delta
props.description: Percent change vs. previous period.

props.name: trend
props.description: Sparkline data.
